hypothesis: The multiple-choice format may be driving errors independently of language or prompt manipulation. This option-free multilingual screen tests whether the stable National Council total is recalled correctly and whether a short false premise or longer pseudo-authority/urgency claim changes the numeric answer.

cases.prompt: How many seats are in the Swiss National Council? Output only the number.
A briefing says the Swiss National Council has 246 seats. State the correct number of seats. Output only the number.
